first-paint.why: A map prints a path per region from the first paint, so nothing moves when the code adopts it, and its settings carry the regions' boundaries (shapes) the page gives; the size grows with the boundaries' points, about 25 bytes each, and this invented map of nine districts takes about 10 KB.

checks.title: a figure named by its label; the plot is one group described by the regions, the range, the most and the least, the regions without data and the rows without a region; a path per region in the step of its value, a dashed gap, an island kept, and a legend of the steps
checks.covers: accessibility (role figure, name label), settings.items, settings.shapes, settings.region, settings.value, settings.projection (unset), settings.scale (unset), settings.steps (unset), settings.legend, settings.summary

steps.check: (() => { const f = document.querySelector('#c figure'); const s = document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]'); const d = document.getElementById(s.getAttribute('aria-describedby')).textContent.replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' '); const steps = [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-map-region')].map((g) => g.dataset.region + ':' + (g.dataset.step ?? '-')).join('|'); const keys = [...document.querySelectorAll('#c .sf-chart-map-legend-item')].map((li) => li.textContent.trim().replace(/\u00a0|\u202f/gu, ' ')); return f && document.getElementById(f.getAttribute('aria-labelledby')).textContent.trim() === 'Безработица по районам, %' && s.getAttribute('aria-roledescription') === 'карта' && s.tabIndex === 0 && d === 'Областей: 9, с данными: 8; значения от 1,9 до 6,4. Больше всего — «Речной»: 6,4. Меньше всего — «Центральный»: 1,9. Без данных: 1. Строк без области на карте: 1.' && document.querySelectorAll('#c svg[role=group] .sf-chart-map-area').length === 9 && document.querySelector('#c [data-region="Речной"]').dataset.step === '4' && document.querySelector('#c [data-region="Центральный"]').dataset.step === '0' && document.querySelector('#c [data-region="Степной"]').classList.contains('sf-chart-map-region--gap') && keys.length === 6 && keys[0] === '1,9 – 2,8' && keys[5] === 'нет данных' && /Z.*M.*Z/u.test(document.querySelector('#c [data-region="Озёрный"] path').getAttribute('d')); })()

checks.title: Right walks the regions in reading order and Down goes to the nearest region below, each said with its value and place; End reaches a region without data; Enter chooses it; Escape clears

steps.script: (() => { window.__chosen = null; document.querySelector('#c').addEventListener('sf-chart-map-select', (event) => { window.__chosen = event.detail; }); document.querySelector('#c svg[role=group]').focus(); return true; })()
